ux.l2c.month.billed: Chat spend through Flux this month: {amount}

ux.l2c.pause.noAccount.line: This Flux Router key is not on a Flux account, so Murage's limit cannot count it.

ux.l2c.pause.fluxBot: Flux Router reached this bot's limit.
ux.l2c.pause.fluxAlso: A limit in Flux Router has also been reached.
ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.title: Murage's limit is a heads-up only for now
ux.l2c.pause.capabilityOff.body: Flux Router stopped sending the account figure Murage needs to pause at your limit. Your bots keep working and the meter still warns you at 80% and 100%. Limits you set inside Flux Router still apply.
ux.l2c.pause.promiseOff: If Flux Router stops offering the account figure, the limit goes back to a heads-up only and Murage tells you.
